# 不息需要更新：生起消耗有限条件时，不息的生成需要更新复现，更新却不蕴含生成 / Unceasing generation needs renewal: where arising depletes finitely many conditions, unceasing generation needs renewal to recur, while renewal does not imply generation

## 主张 Claim

在依存网上，一个形成跨某步生起，当它在该步不活跃、在其后活跃；生成不息，当某个形成在任意晚的步生起（同一形成可以再生起）。生起（变为活跃）是生生第二个“生”的一种读法的形式载体（作者的读法）。一个事件消耗一个有限的条件家族，当在它的每一步，若家族中没有条件上升，则其中某个条件下降；这恰是说事件的每一步家族中有条件变化，与事件的关系不论。从某步起家族中没有条件上升时，消耗它的事件只发生有限次。因此，若生起消耗家族，不息的生成使家族中某个条件在任意晚的步上升（净上升）；若每次上升都由某个活跃形成更新该条件造成，更新的活动在任意晚的步复现。在平衡的流中有不需要净上升的形式：任意晚的步上有正的取用，家族就在任意晚的步得到补充；在其第一个活跃步从家族取用的形成在任意晚的步生起是其一种情形，补充者于是在任意晚的步出现，恒定的取用者而没有任何生起是另一种；生起在这一形式中只经由它带来的取用起作用。这一形式看得见与汲取同步的补充。一个在每个活跃步都使家族中某个条件下降的形成，在家族不再上升之后只活跃有限次，无论它怎样在其中转移依存：替代推迟终结而不逃脱终结。若一个量从不上升而每次生起都使它下降（耗散），生成不是不息的；一个总水平不变的封闭循环可以维持不息的生成。更新可以复现而没有任何生起（月亮更新的潮水），所以在这些前提下不息的生成严格强于复现的更新。形成在汲取一个不被更新的条件时可以接连生起，条件被消耗，生起停止；消耗者可以从一个来源转向另一个而终结。一个形成在源所更新的条件上反复生起，满足全部前提，生成不息；工作候选的逐步读法扣下它的每一次生起，两步周期的读法记入它。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / On a web of dependence, a formation arises across a step when it is inactive at the step and active after it; generation is unceasing when some formation arises at arbitrarily late steps (the same formation may arise again). Arising, becoming active, is the formal carrier of one reading of the second 生 of 生生 (the author's reading). An event depletes a finite family of conditions when, at each of its steps at which no condition of the family rises, one of them falls; this says exactly that some condition of the family changes at each step of the event, whatever its relation to the event. If from some step none of them rises, events depleting the family occur only finitely often. Hence, if arising depletes the family, unceasing generation makes some condition of the family rise (a net rise) at arbitrarily late steps; and if every rise is made by some active formation renewing the condition, renewing activity recurs. Balanced flows give a form that needs no net rise: positive uptake at arbitrarily late steps needs the family replenished at arbitrarily late steps; formations taking from the family at their first active step and arising at arbitrarily late steps are one case, in which renewers recur, and a constant consumer with nothing arising is another; in this form arising works only through the uptake it brings. This form sees replenishment concurrent with drawing. A formation lowering some condition of the family at each active step is active only finitely often once none of them rises any more, however it moves its dependence among them: substitution defers the end and does not escape it. If a quantity never rises and every arising lowers it (dissipation), generation is not unceasing; a closed cycle whose total stays constant sustains unceasing generation. Renewal can recur with nothing arising (a tide the moon renews), so under these premises unceasing generation is strictly stronger than recurring renewal. Formations can arise one after another while drawing an unrenewed condition, consume it, and arising stops; a consumer can move from one source to another and end. A formation arising again and again on a condition the source renews meets every premise and generation is unceasing; the stepwise working candidate withholds each of its arisings, and the reading over cycles of two credits it. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 条件家族是有限列表；水平与流中的量是自然数。 / The family of conditions is a finite list; levels and amounts in flows are natural numbers.
- 消耗前提（P11b 前称支付前提）：在家族都不上升之步，每次生起使家族中某个条件下降。它只要求家族中有条件变化，不涉及生起的形成（Tide）；这是对应前提，不是结论。 / The depletion premise (before P11b, the payment premise): at a step where no condition of the family rises, each arising lowers one of them. It asks only that some condition of the family change and does not involve the arising formation (Tide); it is a correspondence premise, not a conclusion.
- 更新由形成造成（RenewedBy）：每次上升都由某个活跃形成更新该条件造成，展开之外没有更新的来源，太阳或河流也是其中的形成。renews 是应用给出的可观测量；结论只与它一样强。 / Renewal is made by formations (RenewedBy): every rise is made by some active formation renewing the condition, with no source of renewal outside the unfolding; a sun or a river is one of its formations. renews is an observable supplied by the application, and the conclusion is only as strong as it.
- 流的形式（uptake_needs_replenishment、replenishment_recurs、renewing_recurs）：流平衡依存网；取用在任意晚的步为正，或在其第一个活跃步从家族取用的形成（ArisesTaking）在任意晚的步生起。 / The flow form (uptake_needs_replenishment, replenishment_recurs, renewing_recurs): the flow balances the web, and uptake is positive at arbitrarily late steps, or formations taking from the family at their first active step (ArisesTaking) arise at arbitrarily late steps.
- 耗散（dissipation_ceases）：一个量从不上升，而每次生起都使它下降。家族的总水平是这样的量，仅当每次生起都使它下降；总水平预设各条件的单位可公度。对每次生起都耗散的量（例如自由能），这是物理前提。 / Dissipation (dissipation_ceases): a quantity never rises and every arising lowers it. A family's total level is such a quantity only when every arising lowers it, and the total presupposes commensurable units. For a quantity every arising dissipates, free energy for instance, this is a physical premise.
- “不息”只读生起在任意晚的步复现，不读“更多”、多样性或复杂性。 / “Unceasing” reads only that arising recurs at arbitrarily late steps, not “more”, diversity or complexity.

Ren 的原话是“生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向”。本结果只形式化“不断…生”，并把它陈述在整体的继续上，这是作者的读法；生起是第二个“生”的一种读法的形式载体，第二个“生”的范围留给 Ren。在这些前提下，由不被更新的条件承担的生起不能不息；在继续的层面，这与 Ren 所说的生成与退化不重叠相合（作者的读法）；在单个事件的层面，Arises 包括以消耗为条件的生起。所以结果支持来源中 AI 修正说明的看法，即“持续形成新组织”的“持续”已排除消耗型；它没有证明每个非消耗的样式都能不息。作者进一步诠释：在耗散之下，任何有限部分都不能独自不息，不息属于更大的展开（AI 论证；对流中的取用，no-finite-part-bears-taking 在耗散前提下证明了它）；没有耗散，封闭循环可以不息（Recycle）。实际展开是否满足消耗前提、RenewedBy、流的对应与耗散，是经验问题。 / Ren's words are “生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向” (a whole direction of unceasingly creating more 生). This result formalizes only “unceasingly … 生” and states it on the whole's continuation, which is the author's reading; arising is the formal carrier of one reading of the second 生, whose scope is left to Ren. Under these premises, arising borne by unrenewed conditions cannot be unceasing; at the level of continuation this accords with Ren's statement that generation and degeneration do not overlap (the author's reading), while at the level of single events Arises includes arising on a consumed condition. So the result supports the source's AI correction note that the “持续” of “持续形成新组织” already excludes the consuming type; it does not show that every non-consuming pattern can be unceasing. The author further interprets: under dissipation no finite part is unceasing on its own, and unceasing generation belongs to a larger unfolding (an AI argument; for taking in flows, no-finite-part-bears-taking proves it under the dissipation premise); without dissipation a closed cycle can be unceasing (Recycle). Whether actual unfoldings meet the depletion premise, RenewedBy, the flow correspondence and dissipation is an empirical question.

不含伦理谓词，不推出“不息更好”或任何排序；不陈述“更多”、多样性与复杂性；生成成分没有加入 living 的读法；消耗前提只要求家族中有条件变化（depletes_iff），不筛掉命名造成的生起（TideFlip）；两类读法的流的形式中生起只经由取用起作用（Steady），生起的关系项体现时生起本身就是补充（generation-is-replenishment）；Unceasing 依赖跨步的同一（identity-across-steps）：保持持续活动的命名不制造生起，要把定理读作关于生成的定理，需要这样的命名；Rises 是净上升，同步的补充只在流的形式中看得见；RenewedBy 的结论只与应用给出的 renews 一样强；耗散是物理前提（对封闭家族中体现成员的生起，它由平衡、流上的耗散与体现推出，见 generation-is-replenishment），总水平预设单位可公度；条件家族有限；见证都是最小见证；消耗前提、ArisesTaking、RenewedBy 与耗散是应用义务；新名称是审查的建议，最终由 Ren 定。 / Contains no ethical predicate and yields no “unceasing is better” or any ranking; does not state “more”, diversity or complexity; the generation component is not added to any reading of living; the depletion premise asks only that some condition of the family change (depletes_iff) and does not screen out arisings made by naming (TideFlip); in the flow form of the two-kind reading arising works only through uptake (Steady), while the arising of an embodied relatum is itself replenishment (generation-is-replenishment); Unceasing depends on identity across steps (identity-across-steps): a naming that keeps continuing activity makes no arising, and reading the theorems as about generation needs such a naming; Rises is a net rise, and concurrent replenishment is visible only in the flow form; the conclusion of RenewedBy is only as strong as the renews the application supplies; dissipation is a physical premise (for the arisings of embodied members of a closed family it follows from balance, dissipation on flows and embodiment; see generation-is-replenishment), and the total presupposes commensurable units; families of conditions are finite; the witnesses are minimal; the depletion premise, ArisesTaking, RenewedBy and dissipation are application duties; the new names are the reviewer's suggestions, and the final choice is Ren's.

- Related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [substitution-preserves-consumption](substitution-preserves-consumption.md). 该结果中替代条件无代价，焦点形成持续；本结果中替代条件有代价且不被更新，替代链终结（substitution_defers、Relay.defers）。 / There the alternative is free and the focal formation persists; here the alternatives cost and are not renewed, and the chain of substitutions ends (substitution_defers, Relay.defers).
- Related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [relational-reading-comparison](relational-reading-comparison.md). 该结果的整段读法与本结果都读不出“更多”；本结果只给出继续生成在整体继续上的“不息”成分。 / Neither that result's whole-run reading nor this result reads “more”; this result gives only the “unceasing” component of further generation, on the whole's continuation.
- Related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [theory-of-becoming-foundation](theory-of-becoming-foundation.md). 生成、维持、转化、退化与消失中，本结果陈述生起与其不息，以及它与更新、消耗和替代的关系；整体的演绎仍开放。 / Among generation, maintenance, transformation, degeneration and dissolution, this result states arising and its unceasing, and their relation to renewal, consumption and substitution; the whole deduction remains open.
- Related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [more-needs-renewers](more-needs-renewers.md). 在平衡的流中，本结果的对应前提 RenewedBy 成为定理，不息需要补充复现的流的形式也在那里；读作取用者数目的“更多”需要补充与补充者没有最终的界；在活跃形成的普查与 Taking 之下，更多蕴含不息；本结果的振荡者不息却不更多。 / In balanced flows this result's correspondence premise RenewedBy becomes a theorem, and the flow form of unceasing generation needing replenishment lives there; “more”, read as the number of takers, needs replenishment and renewers with no eventual bound; under a census of active formations and Taking, more implies unceasing generation; this result's oscillator is unceasing and not more.
- Related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [generation-is-replenishment](generation-is-replenishment.md). 回答第五次审查 I3：体现的关系项的生起本身需要补充，不经由取用；本结果 dissipation_ceases 的前提，对封闭家族中体现成员的生起，由平衡、耗散与体现推出。 / Answers I3 of the fifth review: the arising of an embodied relatum needs replenishment itself, not through uptake; the premise of this result's dissipation_ceases follows, for the arisings of embodied members of a closed family, from balance, dissipation and embodiment.
- Related, not a proved adapter / 关联而非已证转换: [rising-and-falling-in-one-exchange](rising-and-falling-in-one-exchange.md). 在流的读法中，消耗（Depletes）由平衡、耗散与事件之步上的取用推出（Flow.Balances.depletes），正如 RenewedBy 由平衡与只有活跃者给予推出；这里的对应前提由此化归为流的前提。 / Read through flows, depletion (Depletes) follows from balance, dissipation and taking at the event's steps (Flow.Balances.depletes), as RenewedBy follows from balance with only active formations giving; the correspondence premises here thereby reduce to the flow's.

## 复用与下一增量 Reuse and next delta

“更多”的一种读法（取用者的数目）已由 more-needs-renewers 陈述，流上的耗散由 no-finite-part-bears-taking 陈述；可能性、多样性与复杂性的上升，把生成成分与 Frame.Novel 和 universal_reason 的“新的活的内容”接通，以及生成成分能否进入 living 的读法而不重复“不损”的代价，仍开放；第二个“生”的范围与以消耗为条件的生起是否为生成，属于 Ren。 / One reading of “more” (the number of takers) is stated in more-needs-renewers, and dissipation on flows in no-finite-part-bears-taking; rising possibility, diversity and complexity, connecting the generation component to Frame.Novel and to the “new living content” of universal_reason, and whether a generation component can enter a reading of living without repeating the costs of “no harm” remain open; the scope of the second 生 and whether arising on a consumed condition is generation are Ren's to say.
